reason: 21,000 dinars in fees on 30,000 dinar shoes is almost as much as the shoes. The Instagram pages near me sell the same kind of thing with delivery included for less, and I don't have to wait three weeks or pay a new page up front.
objection: I pay before I see anything to a service nobody I know has used, and if the size is wrong or it looks different from the picture I can't return it. Only damaged items get refunded.
would_change_my_mind: A friend ordering through them first and getting a good item, plus cheaper fees on small light items so a 30,000 dinar order doesn't cost me 50,000.
